evidence.quote: Broadcom BCM2712 2.4GHz quad-core 64-bit Arm Cortex-A76 CPU, with cryptography extensions, 512KB per-core L2 caches and a 2MB shared L3 cache
5V/5A DC power via USB-C, with Power Delivery support

notes.zh: 回答边缘小主机的 CPU、内存档位、PCIe 通道与供电口径，用来判断能不能带得动一块加速模块。不回答它自身的 AI 算力：板载没有 NPU，要接 M.2 或 HAT 形态的加速器才具备推理加速能力。官方给出的量产承诺到 2036 年 1 月，做长期项目时可据此评估供货周期。
notes.en: Answers the CPU, memory tiers, PCIe lane and power figures of a small edge host, which is what decides whether it can carry an accelerator module. It does not answer its own AI throughput: there is no on-board NPU, so inference acceleration requires an M.2 or HAT accelerator. The vendor states production until at least January 2036, which is the figure to use when judging supply for a long-lived project.

specs.PCIe: 2.0 x1 (needs separate M.2 HAT or adapter)
specs.power: 5V/5A DC via USB-C; 27 W PSU recommended
specs.network: Gigabit Ethernet (PoE+ via separate HAT); dual-band 802.11ac
